newsitem.title: USA: Enova's SDG&E '97 return on equity unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Enova's SDG&E '97 return on equity unchanged.

text.p: Enova Corp's San Diego Gas and Electric Co unit agreed on Friday to leave its 1997 return on equity unchanged from this year.
Under the agreement with a unit of the California Public Utilities Commission, customer rates would not increase.

The deal recommends an authorized return on equity of 11.60 percent for operations, compared with SDG&E's request for 11.85 percent. The utility's overall rate of return is set at 9.35 percent, slightly below it's present authorized rate of 9.37 percent. The CPUC is expected to approve the agreement late this year.
